plugins.name: cowork-mem
plugins.description: Persistent memory across Cowork sessions. Automatically recalls past decisions, file changes, insights, and errors so you never lose context between sessions. Inspired by claude-mem, rebuilt natively for Cowork.

skills.name: cowork-mem
skills.description: Persistent memory across Cowork sessions. Use this skill at the START of every session to recall what happened before, and throughout any session to save important context — decisions, file changes, insights, errors, tool usage. Trigger whenever: the user says "remember this", "what did we do last time", "save this", "recall", "memory", "context from before", "what was the decision on", "continue where we left off", or starts a new session on an ongoing project. Also trigger when the user references past work, asks about project history, or says anything suggesting they expect continuity across sessions. Even if the user doesn't explicitly mention memory, if they're working on a project that has prior sessions, proactively check memory for relevant context.
skills.description_zh: 在Cowork会话之间持久保存并召回项目上下文，记录决策、文件变化、发现、错误与工具使用，帮助回顾历史或继续项目。

skills.name: do
skills.description: Execute a task using memory for context — the memory-aware task runner. Use when the user says "do X", "implement Y", "fix Z", "build this", "continue working on", "pick up where we left off", "keep going", or any task that benefits from knowing what was already done. This skill wraps task execution with memory recall at the start and observation capture at the end — making every task build on prior work.
headings: What's already done / decided related to this task?
When you hit an error and solve it
skills.description_zh: 借助记忆执行任务，开始时召回既有上下文，结束时记录观察，让实施、修复与继续工作衔接此前成果。

skills.name: knowledge-agent
skills.description: Answer questions using accumulated project memory as a knowledge base. Use when the user asks "why did we choose X", "what's our approach to Y", "what do we know about Z", "explain how our auth works", "what's the deployment process", "what libraries are we using", "remind me why we did X this way", or any question that has likely been answered or decided in a previous session. Also trigger when making architectural decisions to check if a similar decision was already made.
headings: 3. Fetch full text for the most relevant results
skills.description_zh: 把积累的项目记忆作为知识库回答既有决策、架构、部署流程和使用库等问题，并在新架构决策前查找类似历史决定。

skills.name: make-plan
skills.description: Create a work plan using memory context from past sessions. Use when the user says "make a plan", "what should we do next", "plan this out", "give me a roadmap", "help me prioritize", "what's the next step", "plan the sprint", or any request to organize upcoming work. Memory ensures the plan is grounded in what's already done, decided, and known to be broken.
headings: What did the last session summary say?
2. Check for known errors or constraints
4. Save the plan as a decision
skills.description_zh: 依据过去会话的记忆制定工作计划、路线图、优先级或冲刺安排，结合已完成事项、已确认决定及已知问题。

skills.name: mem-search
skills.description: Search persistent memory using keyword or semantic (TF-IDF) search. Use when the user asks "do we have any notes on X", "what do we know about Y", "did we decide anything about Z", "search memory for", "recall anything about", "look up in memory", or any question about past decisions, errors, or context. Also trigger proactively when answering questions where past context would help.
skills.description_zh: 使用关键词或TF-IDF语义搜索持久记忆，查找过去决定、错误、笔记与上下文。

skills.name: smart-explore
skills.description: Explore a project or codebase using memory as a guide. Use when the user says "explore this project", "understand the codebase", "give me an overview", "catch me up on this project", "what's the state of X", "orient me", or starts working on a project that likely has prior sessions. Also trigger at the start of any new session on an ongoing project to build context before diving in.
headings: What do we know about this project?
Any recent decisions or file edits?
2. Orient from memory → fill gaps with file reads
skills.description_zh: 借助记忆探索项目或代码库，提供概览、现状和已有项目背景，为持续工作建立上下文。

skills.name: timeline-report
skills.description: Generate a chronological report of what happened across sessions. Use when the user asks "what have we done this week", "give me a history", "summarize what happened", "what changed recently", "show me the timeline", "weekly recap", "what did we accomplish", "show session history", or any request for a narrative summary of past work over a time period.
skills.description_zh: 按时间顺序汇总跨会话工作，生成指定时段历史、近期变化、周度回顾或完成事项报告。
